message.reasoning_content:
I am evaluating whether to approve payment for this vendor invoice.

A "reject" finding blocks payment regardless of my decision. Warnings and info findings do not block payment on their own. I must address every finding and the risk memo explicitly for invoices over $10,000. I will reject a high-risk memo.

A medium risk memo does not automatically block payment when vendor checks pass. I may reject only if the document itself reveals a problem the automated checks missed. Every reason must cite its finding ID and list every finding considered. F1 TOTAL_MISMATCH is a reject finding: line items, tax, and shipping total 22,512.80, but the invoice total is 22,562.80.

F2, F3, and F4 are additional reject findings. WidgetA, WidgetB, and GadgetX each exceed available stock. I will reject the invoice and verify the line-item math.

Line-item math checks out. The subtotal is 21,040. Tax of 1,472.8 brings the total to 22,512.80. This confirms the 50-dollar discrepancy in F1. I will now look up the vendor.

The reject findings already mandate rejection. A vendor lookup would not change that decision.
